children: Thailand has the potential to become a regional LNG delivery hub but must ensure its infrastructure is flexible and commercially accessible, a PTT executive said on Tuesday.

"The infrastructure shall be capable of connecting diverse supply sources... with greater speed, efficiency and flexibility," Bandhit Thamprajamchit, chief operating officer of the upstream petroleum and gas business of Thailand's PTT, told an energy forum in Bangkok.
